from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import re

base = Path('docs/plans/2026-09-27-livetest-agent-runtime-residuals_evidence/2026-10-27-verifier-repair')
patterns = [
    re.compile(r'\b(?:sk-(?:proj-)?|gh[pousr]_)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\b'),
    re.compile(r'\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\b'),
    re.compile(r'(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]{12,}'),
    re.compile(r'\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bAIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b'),
    re.compile(r'\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{12,}\b'),
    re.compile(r'-----BEGIN[^\n-]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END[^\n-]*PRIVATE KEY-----'),
]
assignment = re.compile(r'''(?i)(["']?(?:api[_-]?key|[a-z_]*secret|(?:access|refresh|session|auth|control)?[_-]?token|password|authorization)["']?\s*[:=]\s*)(["'])([^"'\n]{8,})\2''')

def redact(text):
    count = 0
    for pattern in patterns:
        text, n = pattern.subn('[REDACTED_POTENTIAL_SECRET]', text)
        count += n
    text, n = assignment.subn(lambda m: m[1] + m[2] + '[REDACTED_POTENTIAL_SECRET]' + m[2], text)
    return text, count + n

receipts = []
for path in sorted(Path('_scratch').glob('test-run.pid-*.log')):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    text, count = redact(raw.decode('utf8', errors='replace'))
    data = text.encode('utf8')
    target = base / (path.name + '.gz')
    target.write_bytes(gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=6, mtime=0))
    receipts.append({'source': str(path), 'retained': target.name, 'sourceBytes': len(raw),
                     'sourceSha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'redactions': count,
                     'retainedUncompressedSha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                     'gzipSha256': hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

def clean_value(value, counter):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text, n = redact(value)
        counter[0] += n
        return text
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [clean_value(v, counter) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: clean_value(v, counter) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value

for path in sorted(Path('_scratch').glob('test-results.pid-*.json')):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    counter = [0]
    report = clean_value(json.loads(raw), counter)
    data = json.dumps(report, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf8')
    target = base / (path.name + '.gz')
    target.write_bytes(gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=6, mtime=0))
    receipts.append({'source': str(path), 'retained': target.name, 'sourceBytes': len(raw),
                     'sourceSha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'redactions': counter[0],
                     'retainedUncompressedSha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                     'gzipSha256': hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

(base / 'full-log-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'All test logs/reports created in this task checkout; full contents retained with potential-secret redaction, no test or outcome changes.',
    'files': receipts,
}, indent=2))
print('Retained', len(receipts), 'complete compressed logs/reports with explicit redaction/hash receipts.')
